description: Defines the AString class, a string utility class with various string manipulation methods, within the Android namespace.

classes.name: AString
classes.description: A string utility class providing string manipulation, comparison, and conversion methods.

methods.name: AString(const char *s, size_t size)
methods.description: Constructs AString from a C-string with specified size.

methods.name: AString(const String8 &from)
methods.description: Constructs AString from a String8 object.

methods.name: AString(const AString &from, size_t offset, size_t n)
methods.description: Constructs AString as a substring of another AString.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the AString content from a C-string or another AString.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the string.

methods.name: c_str
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the string data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the string is empty.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Erases a portion of the string.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends various data types to the string.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts data at a specified position.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a substring starting from a position.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash of the string.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if string starts with a prefix.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if string ends with a suffix.

methods.name: FromParcel
methods.description: Creates an AString from a Parcel object (Android-specific).

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Writes the AString to a Parcel object (Android-specific).
